Фракция станции определяет сторону колон: The station’s faction determines the colonising side. A faction merely being present in the system is not enough.
Цена продажи на станции или флотоносце б: Station or carrier selling prices come from market search results. Your reference estimate does not change those quotes or past trades. Compare demand, distance, pad size and price age before departure.
Prices and demand must be checked in the game.
Цены установки видны в подсказке названи: Installation prices are shown in the service-name tooltip. Services not installed are excluded from totals.
Цены, товар и маршрут будут очищены. Кон: Prices, commodity and route will be cleared. Carrier configuration will be kept. A new wine price is not filled automatically.
Это личный расчёт расходов. Выбранные сл: This is a personal cost estimate. Selected services and money in the game are not changed.
Выберите станцию или введите фракцию из: Choose a station or enter the faction shown in the game
Расчёт Spansh поддерживает личный флотон: Spansh route calculations support personal carriers
